content: ⌊ DRAFT g CSMA/CD configured nodes on a 10BASE-T1S net- work If a CouplingPort is referenced by a CouplingPortConnection with the nodePort reference and the CouplingPort . physicalLayerType is set to 10BASE-T1S and this CouplingPort does not aggregate plcaProps then this Cou- plingPort represents a CSMA/CD configured node in a 10BASE-T1S network.
